inputs.prompt: Image 1 is a crop of a bedroom at night: a wooden desk against a dark teal wall, a chair, and an open laptop whose screen glows soft white. Remove the small mint character from the desk entirely, and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same desk, the same open laptop and its glowing screen, the chair, the wall, the same night light, the same camera position and framing. Render it as a sharp, detailed photographic frame, like a frame from a premium advertising film. Nothing written anywhere.

expect.unit: USD (the endpoint bills in units of 1 dollar, by tokens)
expect.basis: WP1 and WP3 paid 6 to 9 cents for a 2K picture on this model (demo-video/ledger/wp3.csv)

note: Motion test D, key frame 1: a closer shot of the desk at night, the laptop open and lit, nobody there (from a crop of d-little-2-works)
